column1: # BARE-v2.baseline.tsv — the G-T5-BARE baseline for the 82 bare traces of the
# jenkins-markers/v2 corpus (bare = the sidecar's frozen `stamp_class` cell, studies/010 triage).
# claim this file supports and the RULED procedure by which any row here may move.
# ── WHAT THIS FILE CLAIMS, AND WHAT IT NO LONGER CLAIMS ───────────────────────────────────────
# 55 of the 82 rows are still the ORIGINAL PRE-CUT emission and carry the T5 purification's
# before/after null for those traces. 27 rows were RE-EMITTED from the CURRENT purified chain: 7
# on 2026-08-26 on the Founder's explicit ruling, and 26 on 2026-10-05 (6 of them among the 7, so
# 20 new) under the same procedure. Their "pre" side is GONE and NOT RECOMPUTABLE: the
# JenkinsStrategy that produced it is deleted, so a re-emission cannot restore the comparison — it
# re-freezes the current surface as a new baseline. For those 27 traces this file therefore proves
# "nothing has moved since the latest re-emission" and NOTHING about the purification itself.
# A whole-file green means: the bare surface is byte-identical to this file. It does NOT mean
# "the T5 purification moved nothing on the bare class" any more. Do not read the old promise off
# ── PROVENANCE, oldest first — a row here moved by RULING, never by drift ─────────────────────
# emitted 2026-07-30: all 82 rows. Source: the SHIPPED PRE-CUT chain (JenkinsStrategy live) at
#   2-run byte-identical at emit time. Corpus jenkins-markers/v2, REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1.
# re-emitted 2026-08-26: 7 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon 3858821 on
#   linux-gcc16-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus, same
#   REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same run.
#   AUTHORITY: the Founder's ruling of 2026-08-26. CONDITION MET: the movement (7 of 82) was
#   attributed CLOSED by causal experiment to two insight-canon commits — f6169f0 (2026-08-19,
#   6 traces: sv_take_until -> sv_take_until_or_none, which stopped a colon-less remainder
#   collapsing the message body onto `component` and leaving `content` empty) and fb2bfd5
#   (2026-08-18, 2 traces, 1 shared: TokenShape::has_separator gained the wrapper bytes, so a
#   hex run >= 16 wrapped in ( { < " ' now reaches embedded_identity) — and BOTH movements were
#   judged CORRECT defect repairs, so neither could be reverted to satisfy this file. The rows
# re-emitted 2026-10-05: 26 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon abd841f on
#   linux-gcc16-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output (corpus-gates run
#   37285909951 at insight-canon ab6ffb2, reproduced row-for-row at ab6ffb2 and abd841f). Same
#   corpus, same REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same
#   run. CONDITION MET: attributed CLOSED by causal experiment, one build per code commit from
#   7a20b19 (last green, 0 of 82 moved) to abd841f, with each trace's per-line template surface
#   diffed commit to commit: 325493d (DN-134.D1, rule S: a digit-leading core in a complete
#   wrapper shell takes rule 5's disposition, so `(1)`, `[2.1]`, `"5.15.0-164-generic",`,
#   `(2.35-0ubuntu3.8)` mask whole as their bare forms already did) moved all 26; a1e07d2
#   (DN-134.D2, rule K: a number behind `;` masks per segment) also moved
#   path after a declared `"` lead masks under its ephemeral root) also moved
#   No other commit moved a byte. Every moved line read against the three rules' masking.md
#   statements and golden rows and judged a CORRECT application of a ruled mask, so none can be
#   reverted to satisfy this file. The rows re-emitted are the 26 the patch named; the counts
#   columns are unchanged on 22 and distinct_templates falls by 2 to 4 on 4 (lines that differed
#   only in a shelled number now share a template).
